value.notes: Turn 1: probing basic movement, dash, pause and resume. Next: check dash recharge HUD, pause+move same tick, and restart/retry dialogs.

Suspected bug: pause+left in same tick moves the player although pause is first and should ignore the rest of the tick. Run 2 confirms with minimal tokens from start (player at (1,1)). Next: check right+pause; test toasts, restart, dash edge cases.

Run 2 (pause+left from (1,1)) only showed a bump event, no movement; the earlier 'moves' claim was wrong. Testing pause+right from (2,1) to see if the rest of the tick's move is processed after pause. Afterwards: test toasts, restart, dash edge cases, heart/spikes, enemy contact, pause frozen timer.

Suspected bug: keys after pause in the same tick are still processed. Run 3 (right, pause+right) ended at (3,1) paused with ev=[pause,move]; the move should not happen. Run 2 (pause+left from (1,1)) showed a bump event, so input after pause is also processed. Timer and toasts looked frozen in run 3. Next: confirm with the minimal token list pause+right from fresh (1,1). Expected: player stays at (1,1), events=[pause] only. If it moves to (2,1), the bug is confirmed. Then test: does resume after this leave the player at the moved tile? Later: toasts, restart, dash edge cases, heart/spikes, enemy contact, swap-collision.

reports.title: Movement key pressed in the same tick as pause still moves the player while paused
reports.observed: In the tick where pause and a move key are pressed together, the pause takes effect (mode paused, pause menu open) but the move is still applied (events include move; player position changes). The run 'right, pause+right' ended with the player at (3,1) while paused, with events [pause,move]. A bump event also appears for a blocked direction (pause+left at (1,1)).
reports.expected: Pause takes effect immediately; the rest of that tick's input is ignored and nothing else happens in that tick. Player position should not change on the pause tick.

value.notes: Confirmed one bug with a minimal reproduction: a movement key pressed in the same tick as pause still moves the player. From a fresh game with seed 1, pause+right moved the player from (1,1) to (2,1) with events [pause, move], while the game ended paused. The design says that when pause takes effect, the rest of that tick's input is ignored and nothing else happens. Run 2 (pause+left) showed a bump, which is the same root cause, so it is not reported separately. I stopped here because the remaining budget is small. Untested areas: toasts, restart, dash edge cases, hearts and spikes, enemy contact, and swap collisions.

reports.title: Movement key pressed in the same tick as pause still moves the player while paused
reports.observed: From fresh (1,1), tick pause+right: player moves to (2,1), events=[pause,move]; mode=paused, timer unchanged at 300.
reports.expected: Pause takes effect immediately; the rest of that tick's input is ignored, so the player stays at (1,1) with events=[pause] only.
